_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::tsi#11. Both of the claim's lists swept by execution and both wrong. TYPE enum: the 11 catalogued values run one at a time on upstream tsi_lincompression_1waydisp give TYPE_VALUES_ACCEPTED=10, TYPE_VALUES_REFUSED=1, TYPE_VALUES_REFUSED_NAMES=NLS — 'NLS' is not in the enum and draws the same 'The input type NLS is not valid for SOLIDSCATRA elements!' an invented value gets, from 4C_solid_scatra_3D_ele_lib.cpp (the claim names 4C_solid_scatra_ele_lib.cpp, which does not appear: CLAIMED_LIB_FILE_WITHOUT_3D=0). Cell types: sweeping eleven cell types with the right node count each gives CELLTYPES_KNOWN_TO_SOLIDSCATRA=HEX8 HEX27 TET4 TET10 NURBS27 and CELLTYPES_REFUSED_BY_SOLIDSCATRA=QUAD4 QUAD9 TRI3 TRI6 PYRAMID5 WEDGE6, each refused with "Element 'SOLIDSCATRA' does not seem to know cell type '<ct>'." from 4C_fem_general_element_definition.cpp. So the claimed 2D support (QUAD4, QUAD9, TRI3, TRI6) does not exist, consistent with tsi#0. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: The input type NLS is not valid for SOLIDSCATRA elements!
CELLTYPES_REFUSED_BY_SOLIDSCATRA=QUAD4 QUAD9 TRI3 TRI6 PYRAMID5 WEDGE6
Element 'SOLIDSCATRA' does not seem to know cell type 'quad4'.
Element 'SOLIDSCATRA' does not seem to know cell type 'tri6'.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the TYPE sweep: drop the invented 'NLS' from the swept list, leaving the ten values the element really accepts. TYPE_VALUES_REFUSED then falls to 0 and the NLS diagnostic disappears, so the fixture must go red.
_mutation.from: CLAIMED_TYPES="Undefined AdvReac CardMono GR NLS Chemo ChemoReac ElchDiffCond \
_mutation.to: CLAIMED_TYPES="Undefined AdvReac CardMono GR Chemo ChemoReac ElchDiffCond \

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the cell-type sweep: ask only about the 3D cell types the element declares. CELLTYPES_REFUSED_BY_SOLIDSCATRA loses its 2D entries and the quad4/tri6 diagnostics disappear, so the fixture must go red.
